CommunityApplications.Profile: Community Applications repository maintained by Peter Hecko, packaging MagicMirror² for Unraid. MagicMirror² is an open source modular smart mirror platform. This template runs it in server-only mode, the correct mode for a headless Unraid server: the interface is served over HTTP and rendered in a browser or on a separate client device such as a Raspberry Pi. The container image is karsten13/magicmirror, built and maintained by Karsten Hassel at https://gitlab.com/khassel/magicmirror. This repository provides only the Unraid packaging and does not fork, rebuild or modify that image. Report template issues at https://github.com/heckpiet/magicmirror-unraid/issues, image issues at https://gitlab.com/khassel/magicmirror/-/issues and MagicMirror² or module issues at https://forum.magicmirror.builders.
